query: Japan hand-foot-and-mouth disease (手足口病) national cases per sentinel (定点当たり報告数) provisional figure for Week 27 2026 (June 29 - July 5), from IDWR / JIHS. Also confirm Week 25 and Week 26 2026 national values.
answer:
## Summary

I confirmed all three requested figures for Japan's national HFMD sentinel surveillance (定点当たり報告数) from IDWR/JIHS:

| Week | Period | Cases per sentinel | Status |
|------|--------|-------------------|--------|
| **Week 27** | Jun 29 – Jul 5, 2026 | **7.03** | **Provisional (速報)**, published 2026-07-14 |
| **Week 26** | Jun 22 – Jun 28, 2026 | **4.61** | Confirmed, published 2026-07-10 |
| **Week 25** | Jun 15 – Jun 21, 2026 | **3.40** | Confirmed, published 2026-06-24 |

**Key points:**
- The **Week 27 provisional value of 7.03** (15,845 total reports) crossed the national alert threshold of 5.0 — the first time in ~2 years — with **27 prefectures** exceeding 5.0. It is subject to later revision; the next update (Week 28) is due July 21, 2026.
- **Week 26 = 4.61** cross-confirmed by two independent Jiho pharmaceutical-industry sources citing the official JIHS release.
- **Week 25 = 3.40** confirmed by JMED and regional surveillance summaries.
- Clear continuous upward trajectory since Week 20 (1.41 → 1.98 → 2.75 → 3.40 → 4.61 → 7.03), with the outbreak spreading from western Japan into the Kanto/metropolitan region by Weeks 25–26.

Full structured findings with all data points and sources have been submitted.

key_facts: Week 27 2026 (June 29–July 5) national HFMD cases-per-sentinel: 7.03 (PROVISIONAL/速報), published by JIHS 2026-07-14
Week 27 total national reports: 15,845 cases; 27 prefectures exceeded the 5.0 alert threshold; first national crossing of 5.0 in ~2 years
Week 26 2026 (June 22–28) national HFMD cases-per-sentinel: 4.61 (confirmed), published 2026-07-10; 10,396 total reports; 7th consecutive weekly increase
Week 25 2026 (June 15–21) national HFMD cases-per-sentinel: 3.40 (confirmed), published 2026-06-24; 7,576 total reports
Continuous rising trend since Week 20: Wk22 1.41, Wk23 1.98, Wk24 2.75, Wk25 3.40, Wk26 4.61, Wk27 7.03 (provisional)
Top prefectures at Week 27: Shimane 18.00, Saga 11.83, Tokyo ~11.72, Chiba ~11.59, Toyama ~10.69
Reporting authority is JIHS (国立健康危機管理研究機構), successor to NIID; HFMD is a Category-5 sentinel-reported (定点把握) disease under IDWR
Week 27 value is provisional (速報) and may be revised; next update (Week 28) scheduled 2026-07-21
